package.name: @vmitsaras/raveldex
package.description: Native modular TypeScript local search — ESM core with BM25, atomic mutations, cooperative execution, optional search capabilities and native DOM UI.

scripts.check: npm run handoff:check && npm run docs:check && npm run typecheck && npm test
scripts.test: npm run build && node --test --test-concurrency=4 --test-timeout=180000 test/tooling/*.test.mjs test/core/*.test.mjs test/consumer/*.test.mjs test/addons/phrases/*.test.mjs test/addons/positions/*.test.mjs test/addons/filters/*.test.mjs test/addons/facets/*.test.mjs test/addons/inspector/*.test.mjs test/addons/evidence/*.test.mjs test/adapters/snapshots/*.test.mjs test/migration/converter.test.mjs test/comparison/*.test.mjs && node --test --test-timeout=120000 test/ui/*.test.mjs && node --test --test-timeout=120000 test/adapters/worker/*.test.mjs && node --test --test-timeout=120000 test/adapters/indexeddb/*.test.mjs && node --test --test-timeout=120000 test/migration/packed-browser.test.mjs
scripts.typecheck: tsc -p tsconfig.json && tsc -p test/types/tsconfig.json && tsc -p tsconfig.ui.json && tsc -p tsconfig.worker.json && tsc -p tsconfig.indexeddb.json && tsc -p tsconfig.migration.json
scripts.build: node scripts/clean-build.mjs && tsc -p tsconfig.build.json && tsc -p tsconfig.ui.build.json && node scripts/copy-ui-css.mjs && tsc -p tsconfig.worker.build.json && tsc -p tsconfig.indexeddb.build.json && tsc -p tsconfig.migration.build.json && node scripts/copy-migration-license.mjs
scripts.test:migration: npm run build && node --test --test-timeout=120000 test/migration/converter.test.mjs test/comparison/*.test.mjs && node --test --test-timeout=120000 test/migration/packed-browser.test.mjs

method.timing: Page performance.now on complete public promise including same-host worker capture/transport/result and cooperative native work. Whole-ms ceil-rounded samples. Fresh worker/engine owner per repeat; browser process and page modules warm. First query before two discarded warmups/five measured calls. Save/load include snapshot serialization/restoration plus real strict-hint IndexedDB transaction. Those combined measures are not subtraction-derived isolated I/O cost.
method.work: Worker/storage execution counters are not exposed by the public browser facade. Actual native loop counts exist only in separate untimed Node observer diagnostics. No transport/storage work count is inferred from them.

configuration.query: Native exact ASCII text AND, exact full total plus deterministic BM25 top20. Strict phrase additionally requires same token sequence in one original field value.
configuration.filter: No filter/facet requested. Core scalar equality is available; extended metadata predicates and facets are uninstalled in these measured configurations.
configuration.count: Exact complete membership count before top20.
configuration.evidence: No Inspector, range/snippet output or rendering requested.
configuration.analyzer: basic-v1 NFKC then lowercase; this ASCII fixture does not compare Unicode platform behavior.
configuration.limits: Unchanged default admission, corpus, search/mutation work and optional participant bounds. Deadline 60000ms; batchSize256.
configuration.worker: one same-host module worker complete native owner
configuration.storage: explicit source snapshot IndexedDB adapter, separate caller namespace per size/repeat
configuration.nativeSnapshots: Not Applicable: source-only worker bridge and unqualified browser profile

limitations: Node direct and Chrome worker timings have different runtime/realm/environment and cannot isolate worker overhead.
Three fresh owner samples per build/update/export/restore/save/load; fifteen warm query samples per size. Maximum is observed only, not population percentile.
One synthetic ASCII fixture, one headless Chrome/macOS host. No cross-browser/native-portability or admitted-corpus universal capacity claim.
Observed IndexedDB completion/store rows are not power-loss durability, eviction retention, quota/device or memory qualification.
No UI rendering, physical paint, heap, assistive-technology or physical latency measurement.
